title: Minimum Cost to Reach Destination in Time
description: An undirected edge `[u,v,t]` takes `t` minutes to traverse. Visiting node `i` incurs `passingFees[i]`. Starting at node 0 at time 0, return the minimum total fee to reach node `n-1` within `maxTime`; return -1 if impossible. Fees are paid once each time a node is visited.
hints: Represent the graph with adjacency lists or a distance matrix appropriate to the limits.
Track shortest-distance states and respect all time or threshold rules.
